_comment: Reel specs for the v2 Pro launch campaign. Copy is the source of truth in
marketing/content/My Body - Pro Launch Instagram Campaign v2 (Aug 2026).md
— keep the hooks here identical to that file.
TWO RULES THIS FILE EXISTS TO ENFORCE:
1. NO HOOK NAMES A PRICE. Not one. Price is a closing line in a caption and
a number on the paywall. Nobody has ever stopped scrolling for a pricing
architecture. Every hook below opens on doubt, fear, secrecy, waste or
relief — the things this audience actually feels.
2. NEVER ILLUSTRATE THE PROBLEM WITH OUR OWN SCREENS. Say the problem in
words; show our apps only as the answer. An earlier draft put 'none of
them talk to each other' over our own screenshots, which reads as a
confession rather than a diagnosis.
requires: 'pro_live' means the post claims Pro is buyable or names a price,
so the poster must refuse it until store/submissions/launch-status.txt says
the subscriptions are approved.
Guideline 1.4.2: opt-03-calculator.png and opt-04-levels.png are deliberately
unused. Do not add them to any beat.
THE FIRST TWO SECONDS, learned the expensive way on 5 August 2026.
h3-deadline was published and Facebook reported 179 views, 164 viewers,
0 interactions, 0 follows and an AVERAGE WATCH TIME OF TWO SECONDS, with
retention falling off a cliff at the 0:02 mark. Reach was never the problem
— most of it came from Recommendations. Pulling the frames apart found three
faults, all now fixed in build_reels.py:
- frame 0 carried no words, because hook text ramped in over 0.45s on top
of a crossfade. The thumbnail was an anonymous dark dashboard.
- the hook reused beats[0].src, so the picture did not change for the
first six and a half seconds.
- crossfading two segments that share a picture superimposed both text
layers into a legible double exposure that read as a broken render.
So: hook text is present on frame 0, neighbouring segments sharing an image
hard-cut, and hookStyle 'type' opens on words alone with the first device
shot arriving as the answer. Watch time is Instagram's number one ranking
signal — a weak opening does not just lose viewers, it teaches the algorithm
to stop distributing. Check the retention curve before changing a hook.

reels.hook:
Four months in.
Could you actually prove it is working?

beats.text: You logged the doses.
You did the sessions.
You hit the protein.
The proof only appears when they share a timeline.

reels.hook:
The reason you stopped logging
last time was the logging.

beats.text: Last session's numbers are already there.
The rest timer starts itself.
Three seconds a set. That is the whole bar.

reels.hook:
Friday: six months free.
Saturday: you pay.

beats.text: No code. Nothing to claim.
If your account exists before that date, it is applied.

reels.hook:
This is the sentence you want
to be able to say out loud.

beats.text: Down six kilos.
Strength held.
Protein at 142 a day.
Three datasets. One account. It writes itself.

reels.hook:
You will not remember
what you did in March.

beats.text: You think you will. You will not.
Six months of effort, unaccounted for.
Unless something was quietly writing it down.

reels.hook:
The reason you gave up tracking
last time was the setting up.

beats.text: Point the camera at the label.
Read on the device. Nothing uploaded.
And it is on your day. That was the setup.

reels.hook:
I needed to know whether any of it
was actually doing anything.

beats.text: So the chart marks the day you started.
It takes that date from your protocol.
A standalone workout app cannot draw that line.

reels.hook:
I never turned this on.
It just knew.

beats.text: A GLP-1 protocol, logged in Optimise.
Fuel switched itself to muscle retention.
Protein first. Calories second.

reels.hook:
The weight is coming off.
That is not the part to watch.

beats.text: On a GLP-1 you are already eating under.
What decides how much you keep is protein.
Lose the fat. Keep the muscle.

reels.hook:
Week one of charging money.
Here is the number I would rather not post.

beats.text: Subscribers. Downloads.
Refunds. Cancellations. Same size type.

reels.hook:
You are doing everything right.
You just cannot see it yet.

beats.text: Your strength says one thing.
Your protein says another.
One number for whether they agree with your goal.

reels.hook:
Nobody in my life
knows I am on this.

beats.text: It works with the phone in airplane mode.
No ads. No data sales. No tracking.
Face ID on the app. Photos stay on the device.
Then take just that one.
Every app has its own plan.
Add the others whenever. Never charged twice.

reels.hook:
You already have the answer.
It is sitting in three different places.

beats.text: A fortnight of protocol.
The same fortnight of training.
The same fortnight of food.
One timeline, and suddenly you can read it.

reels.hook:
I did not want to charge you
three times for one body.

beats.text: Three apps, one account.
Built to share data from the first day.
So one subscription covers all three.

reels.hook:
A doctor asked what I had been doing.
I could not answer.

beats.text: It was all written down somewhere.
None of it was written down together.
Now it takes about four seconds.

reels.hook:
You were worried
I would take something away.

beats.text: Everything that was free is still free.
Pro added the deeper end on top.
That is the whole of what changed.
